verdict.rationale: Segment's first-party Engage docs confirm that audiences can be built from tracking events (behavior), traits, computed traits and other audiences, then synced to destinations. The evidence never describes a visual, no-SQL builder or an audience-size estimate shown before activation, so only the core grouping capability is documented. Missing for 10: documentation of a visual/no-code audience builder, no-SQL authoring, estimated audience size before activation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audiences from traits and behavior in a visual builder — no SQL required — and see estimated size before activating

citations.quote: Audiences let you group users or accounts based on event behavior and traits that Segment tracks.
You can build Audiences from core **tracking events**, **traits**, and **computed traits**. You can then sync Audiences to hundreds of [Destinations]
You can build an audience from existing events, traits, computed traits, or other Audiences.
Twilio Engage is a customizable personalization platform with which you can build, enrich, and activate Audiences.
